name: coroslink-relay
description: Setup-only relay for the CorosLink remote Coach: links desktops, provisions Cloudflare Tunnels, brokers one-time credentials and sends push.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" --outdir dist
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply coroslink-relay-dev --remote --env dev
